Subject: SOC 2 walkthrough — evening slot options + procurement note

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for the quick intake call last week. We want to make the live walkthrough as painless as possible for your ops team — would an evening window (US Pacific/EMEA overlap) work for you? We generally propose a 90–120 minute block for the walkthrough + Q&A so we can cover architecture, evidence mapping, and the pen-test handoff.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Nov 17, 7:00 PM–8:30 PM
- Wed Nov 18, 6:30 PM–8:30 PM

Two quick asks: can you confirm the procurement contact for DPA/PO/DocuSign (Caleb? procurement@finco.com), and whether you want a separate procurement-only cadence before the walkthrough? If so we can loop in Laura (cc'd) from our commercial ops.

I attached our lightweight evidence matrix and a short runbook for evening ops. If you prefer a different cadence, happy to adapt.

Cheers,
Ben

Thanks Alice — looping Caleb and our internal teams.

Caleb — quick intro: FinCo is requesting an evening SOC 2 walkthrough (7–8:30 PM PST on Tue 11/17). Laura will coordinate the commercial/procurement steps and share the DocuSign packet; Olga (security) will own the technical agenda and evidence checklist during the call.

Olga — can you confirm the run order? My recommendation:
1) 5–10 min intro & objectives (Ben/Alice)
2) 25–30 min architecture/dataflow + isolation controls (Olga)
3) 20–25 min evidence mapping & how to pull artifacts post-call (Olga)
4) 20–30 min pen-test scoping questions and timeline (Alice + pen vendor)
5) 10–15 min next steps & procurement/DocuSign milestone (Laura)

Laura — if you can draft a conditional DocuSign packet and share a short checklist for Caleb/procurement that would be great. We can run the walkthrough on your Zoom or ours; we prefer the FinCo bridge if you have a specific security posture, but either works.

Ben
